You will be given the occupation, its three ring tasks and their detailed work activities, and a complete worked example from accounting.

The rule language. Expressions use numbers, the variables V1 V2 V3 V4 (case magnitudes from the documents), SEV or ANNEX_SEVERITY (a severity in [0,1] from the annex), PRIMARY_CUTOFF and RATIO_CUTOFF, names defined by earlier LETs, registry constants written REG.<name>, the operators + - * / **, parentheses, MIN(a, b), MAX(a, b), and the conditional `a IF condition ELSE b` where the condition compares two expressions with >= > <= < ==. (4) The precedent rule (tier3_rule) must use at least two REG.<name> constants and a tier3 LET that couples SEV with V2 (an interaction). (5) Treatments must be finite and of the same order as the example for V1 in [100, 900], V2 in [0.02, 0.25], V3 in [20, 120], V4 in [100, 500], SEV in [0, 1], and the four rules must give different treatments on typical cases.
